# Minutesmith

> Minutesmith is a macOS app that records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings and lectures entirely on-device. There is no account, no cloud, and no server of the developer's — recordings, transcripts, and summaries stay on the user's Mac unless they explicitly opt into a third-party AI provider using their own API key.

## Pages
- [Home](https://minutesmith.dev/): What Minutesmith is, how it works, and its privacy stance.
- [Features](https://minutesmith.dev/features.html): The full list of what the app does.
- [Blog](https://minutesmith.dev/blog/): Notes on privacy-first software, on-device AI, and building Minutesmith.
- [Support](https://minutesmith.dev/support.html): How to get help, report a bug, and fix recording permissions.
- [Privacy policy](https://minutesmith.dev/privacy.html): How data is handled (it stays local by default).

## Key facts
- Platform: macOS 12 or later, Apple silicon.
- Records the microphone and system audio together (Zoom, Teams, Meet), so the transcript captures everyone on the call.
- Transcription runs locally with an on-device Whisper model and works fully offline.
- Summaries are shaped by meeting-type templates: Standup, Weekly Sync, Sales Call, Lecture, and General.
- Summarization runs on a local model by default; optionally connects to OpenAI, Anthropic, or a self-hosted Ollama instance using the user's own API key, sent directly from the Mac to that provider.
- "Ask" feature answers plain-English questions about a transcript.
- Meetings are stored as plain files in a local, searchable library and can be exported.
- No account, no sign-up, no analytics, and no tracking.
- Available on the Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/minutesmith/id6788589489?mt=12
